messages:
From: Phil Grant <phil@nxsys.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace sandbox migration: SI dependency sweep

Hi Soojin / Jonas / Camila,

Following up on our onboarding call — Nexus is ready to begin the sandbox migration for the Redwood marketplace listing, but we hit a few blocking dependencies on our side that we need to align on before the cutover window. Attaching the dependency CSV with owners and current status (nexus-migration-deps-20270706.csv).

High-level blockers we've identified: 
- Entitlement mapping: we need canonical SKU ids and a sample entitlement payload for the staging environment.
- Billing hooks: sandbox billing endpoint and test invoice flow (sandbox tokens).
- OAuth/SSO: redirect URIs for the marketplace UI + service-account scopes for CI deploys.
- Staging infra: dedicated sandbox project with >= 4 vCPUs and a 2T object-store quota for our test data.
- E2E test accounts: test users + sample prompts to validate latency & correctness.

We'd like to propose a small sweep this week to: 1) agree owners per row in the attached CSV, 2) lock a 2-week migration window (target start 2027-07-20), and 3) validate acceptance criteria for automation.

Can you confirm who on the Redwood side will own entitlement mapping and sandbox billing? Also please flag any additional constraints (security review / SOC evidence) we should expect.

Thanks,
Phil Grant
Partner Engineering Lead
Nexus Systems

Attachments: nexus-migration-deps-20270706.csv (text/csv)

Thanks Phil — this is helpful. I reviewed the CSV and added a couple comments; I think we can cover most items but want to be explicit about owners and SLOs. Quick answers: 

- Entitlement mapping: Owner will be Product (Camila) for the schema + Partner Ops (Jonas) for ingestion. We need sample entitlement payloads from you (format + example users).
- Billing hooks: Redwood can provide a sandbox billing webhook URL and test tokens; Finance will want to sign off on the test invoice flow.
- OAuth/SSO: Engineering (Ben) will provision redirect URIs; we'll need the exact redirect list and a description of your CI service account usage.
- Staging infra: I'll coordinate with Infra but we can provision the sandbox project under Redwood-staging-03. Note that storage quotas are limited during business hours — if you need >1T sustained, we'll need a brief capacity exception.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Quick alignment call (30m) Thursday 2027-07-08 16:00-16:30 UTC — propose if that works for Nexus.
2) Camila to draft acceptance criteria (API/entitlement + billing smoke tests) by EOD 2027-07-09.
3) Ben to open a Jira ticket for OAuth redirect provisioning and attach instructions for Nexus CI.

Phil — please confirm availability for Thu or suggest two windows.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partner Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I pulled the CSV and sketched acceptance criteria. A few product-specific asks to clarify scope so we don’t iterate on the wrong plan: 

1) Entitlement model: Redwood supports both user- and org-level entitlements. Nexus — which do you expect to validate in sandbox? If org-level, we need:
   - canonical org_id mapping example (preferably UUID),
   - sample entitlement TTL semantics (30 days / 90 days), and
   - expected behavior when a user belongs to multiple orgs.

2) Feature flags & rollout: For the migration, we want to test a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) using our flagging layer. That means Nexus must be able to target headers or account identifiers in the test harness.

3) Regression checks: We will include the marketplace canonical prompts in the E2E test set. Please provide 6 representative prompts (happy path + 2 edge cases + 3 long-context cases).

4) Security/compliance: If Nexus needs SOC2 artifacts for the environment, we can provide redacted evidence for the staging project but not production credentials. Let us know the scope.

I'll prepare a short doc with acceptance criteria and an example entitlement payload and drop it into the shared Drive by EOD.

Camila Reyes
Product Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
